# Plenor Group

> Plenor Group LLC is a Florida-based boutique operations consulting firm founded May 30, 2026 by Everton Paula. Plenor turns board-approved strategy into a running operation, sitting between MBB strategy engagements and in-house operations teams. One accountable operator owns every engagement. The deliverable is a running operating engine with named internal owners, written playbooks, and a metric tree the team uses on Monday mornings. Plenor leaves on a named date.

## What Plenor does

Plenor operates in three modes. Mode 1 is post-strategy operationalization: 90 to 180 days, fixed-scope, phase-billed, installs the operating engine after a board-approved strategy and hands off to a named internal owner. Mode 2 is fractional operating leadership: 6 to 12 months, monthly retainer, 2 to 3 days per week, senior operator in the seat until a full-time hire is closed with a 30-day overlap. Mode 3 is operating diligence and review: 2 to 6 weeks, day-rate or fixed-fee, written report (12 to 20 pages) and executive readout for boards, PE sponsors, and founders.

The entry offer is the Operating Teardown: a one-week, fixed-fee read on an operation. One operator delivers a short written document naming the three to five things breaking the operation, ranked by operating cost, with the fix sequence and a 60-minute readout. It is Phase 1 of the Bridge Method (Diagnose) sold standalone, and the fee is credited in full toward a Mode 1 or Mode 2 engagement booked within 30 days of the readout.

The core method is the Bridge Method, a four-phase engagement: Diagnose (weeks 1 to 2), Design (weeks 2 to 4), Stand up (months 2 to 4), Hand off (month 5 and after). Phases compress for diligence and extend for fractional leadership; the structure stays the same.

## Who Plenor is for

Series A to Series C operators with a recently approved strategy and a six to nine month operating ramp. Founders running multiple workstreams personally that should belong to operating leads. Boards bridging a known operating gap during a transition. PE sponsors during diligence or in the first 100 days post-close.

Plenor does not write strategy, run analyst pyramids, deliver decks as final artifacts, work with pre-revenue companies, or stay past the handoff.

## Founder

Everton Paula, 15+ years operating inside marketplaces, fintech, last-mile platforms, and DTC businesses. Operating responsibility across 8 countries and 9 markets at companies between Series B and post-IPO scale. Direct P&L ownership up to $40M. Operating systems processing 5M+ daily transactions at peak. Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt. Based in Tampa, FL.
